mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet-activating factor and has anticoagulant/antiplatelet properties, while tamoxifen increases thrombotic risk; combined use elevates bleeding risk. Additionally, both may compete for CYP450 metabolism, potentially altering tamoxifen levels.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; counsel patient to report unusual bruising, bleeding, or blood in urine/stool; consider alternative herbal products with lower bleeding risk.
